title: Machine profile
description: Resource limits and engine settings for a specific machine.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

minFreeMemoryMb.description: Minimum free memory in MB required to start.

watchMemoryMb.description: Abort if MemAvailable drops below this many MB during generation.

device.description: Preferred device, for example Vulkan0 or cpu.

fallbackDevice.description: Device used if the preferred one is unusable.

ollama.description: What the worker does with the models Ollama keeps in memory when it takes the machine lock: unload them (default), abort the job or ignore them.

ollamaUrl.description: Address of Ollama (local host only; GRUN_OLLAMA_URL wins; default http://localhost:11434).

produce.description: Base models usable to produce lines on this machine.
